Input image 2 is the APPROVED CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE, not a layout to copy. Repaint the eight poses from image 1 in precisely the smooth hand-drawn style of image 2. Boston has brown swept hair with gray temples, angular clean-shaven face, dark navy/blue-teal short-sleeve T-shirt, orange pants, dark boots. No sunglasses. Keep exactly 8 separate cels in their original slots and exact original poses, direction, proportions, silhouette and crop. Face and neck must join body naturally. Do not increase head size, muscles or height. Each original pixel cluster is the anatomical shape it represents. Do not add missing body parts: these are partial poses emerging from water, so submerged parts remain absent. Flat waterline crops and thin trailing dark fragments are deliberate. No scene, ground, labels, borders, text, shadows or water added outside original visible shapes. Clean nuanced thin outlines, controlled painted shading, not photorealistic, not modern 3D, not pixel art. Output 1536x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha. Trace the original outlines and locations closely. Preserve the exact eight-cell layout.
